params.body:
Two things Shane saw on the own-stock list on 15 September 2026.

## The sold dialog

The "verkocht / overgekocht" question had three buttons in a flex-end row with `flex-wrap` inside a 460px dialog, so "Bestelbon zonder schade" broke onto its own line under the other order button, at 1440 as much as on a phone.

The footer is now the three-action row (R S4-8.14): a 600px dialog (`ui-modal-actions`), cancel quiet on the left (last in the DOM, `order: -1`), the two order buttons together on the right. Under 640px every button is a full-width row, the order buttons in the same order, cancel at the bottom; never one orphan on a second line. The buttons are `ui-button` instead of `btn btn-primary` / `btn-secondary`. The warning icon gets its own flex class (`ui-modal-warning`): the theme turns `.d-flex` into block under md and put it above the sentence on a phone.

The question keeps saying a sold vehicle can only be copied: that is R S4-8.4 (sold is final, back online is a copy).

## The relation picker from the own stock

"Bestelbon zonder schade maken" from a row opened an order form whose Relatie field could not choose anyone. Root cause: the relation picker (`#relationModal`, its iframe and `slRelatieNaarModal`) is a partial the PAGE carries; the order modal comes in over AJAX and only points at it with `data-target`. The sheet (`edit.blade.php`, `vehicle_form_preview.blade.php`) included the partial, the Livewire list (`livewire_preview.blade.php`) did not, so `modal.show('#relationModal')` found nothing and returned without an error. From the sheet the same modal worked, which is what Shane noticed.

The list now includes the same partial as the sheet (R S4-4.16). And the whole Relatie field is the opener on the order, offer and loan forms: the `ui-affix` wrapper carries `data-toggle`/`data-target`, `role="button"` and `tabindex="0"`; the input stays `disabled` (a disabled field never travels with the form, and `OrderController::create` takes the request as it comes, so `readonly` would have put `relation_name` into the insert) and lets clicks through with `pointer-events: none`; the person icon is decoration inside the opener, not a second trigger; Enter and space open it too. The field reads as a field you can click, not as one that is switched off. Verified in the browser: pick lands `relation_id` and the display name in the form and enables the Overname wagen list (R S4-4.14).

## Screenshots

Before/after at 1440 and 390 in `.playwright-mcp/sold-order-modals/` of the worktree: `sold-{1440,390}-{before,after}.png`, `order-{1440,390}-{before,after}.png`, `picker-{1440,390}-{before,after}.png` (before: the picker does not open; after: it does), `order-picked-{1440,390}-after.png`.

## Tests

`SoldDialogLayoutTest` (footer order and classes, the stylesheet's wide and narrow halves, the R S4-8.4 sentence), `RelationPickerEntryPointsTest` (the list page carries the picker; sheet and list include the same partial; the Relatie field of a new order carries the opener exactly once with a disabled input; the picker script opens on Enter and space). Filter `Order|Relation|Sold|Dialog|HandlerWiring|AlpineExpression|CompiledViews|StylesheetSyntax|RulesCoverage|RulesIdentity`: OK (154 tests, 1236 assertions).

Findings: `2026-09-15-verkocht-dialoog-knoppen-slordig.md` (opgelost, later), `2026-09-15-relatiekiezer-vanaf-de-wagenlijst.md` (opgelost, nu). Rules R S4-4.16 and R S4-8.14 added.
params.title: The sold dialog lines up its buttons and the order form's relation picker opens from the own stock
